items.title: Kimi K3: The open-weights escalation
items.summary: On Thursday July 16th, Moonshot AI released their latest flagship model Kimi K3 . K3 is a 2.8T parameter MoE model which will have its weights released on July 27th. Much of this article follows as a reflection on the state of the ecosystem, under the assumption that Moonshot keeps their promise of the weights release date. items.summaryZh: Moonshot AI推出了其最新的旗舰模型Kimi K3，这是一个2.8T参数的混合专家（MoE）模型，计划于7月27日开源权重。K3在多项公开评测和代码竞技场中表现优异，成为开源界最接近前沿闭源模型的代表之一，显著缩小了开源与闭源以及中美模型性能的差距。

aiReview.reasonZh: 月之暗面发布2.8T参数MoE旗舰模型Kimi K3并计划开源，展现了中国实验室在基础架构和缩放能力上的强大进展。

items.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
items.summary: OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, highlighting new safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards through iterative deployment.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI分享了在部署长周期运行AI模型过程中的经验教训，重点探讨了伴随模型能力增强而出现的新型安全风险、实际观察到的故障模式，以及通过迭代部署不断完善防护机制的具体举措。原始信息显示：OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, highlighting new safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards through iterative deployment.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI分享了部署长周期运行AI模型的安全经验与防护改进，对行业长效对齐具有重要参考价值。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: Grok for Excel
items.summary: Use the Grok add-in for Microsoft Excel to ask questions in plain English, write formulas, and run scenarios without leaving the workbook.
